missing: Tested recommendations: specific power station (or inverter generator) models with measured noise in dB, usable Wh, real fridge/CPAP runtime, and solar recharge times; none of the sources name and test actual products.
why: The only major-reviewer/authority sources (Consumer Reports x3, WVU Extension) are about gas generators or general safety and don't recommend a quiet alternative. The question is answered conceptually—battery power station, with inverter generator as a quieter gas option—by two substantive niche sites ([9], [10]) and a pile of near-duplicate affiliate explainers, but nothing with lab-tested products or noise figures.
